sources.summary: NB01 House is located on a complex residential site in Ninh Binh, Vietnam, where several existing structures had been repeatedly extended and altered over many years. These accumulated interventions created a fragmented and disordered environment that no longer responded effectively to the family's daily needs. The site is also exposed to significant environmental pressures: it borders a busy national highway and faces the North–South railway line, resulting in constant traffic noise, dust, and visual disturbance.
